featured_story.title: Faith in Action: Serving Communities in Jamaica
featured_story.intro: Working alongside Fresh Bread Ministries, Refuge of Hope, and dedicated ministry partners, the AH Foundation helped support outreach efforts throughout Montego Bay and the Westmoreland region of Jamaica.
highlights: Health screenings and basic medical support
featured_story.closing: This is what meaningful partnership looks like: organizations coming together to serve people and strengthen communities.
